literature_refs: structural assumption: fixed warm-up oil price for pre-1960 window
prior_description: Fixed nominal USD oil price used as the explicit structural warm-up forcing for 1957Q1-1959Q4; the World Bank monthly series starts 1960-01 and observed values are never backfilled into the warm-up.
uncertainty_notes: Engineering prior range only; no calibration and no sensitivity assessment were performed, and the selected value is not a historical estimate.
